Subtitle: by VM233
AboutText: VM Unity MCP is maintained and released by VM233 as a standalone repository. It provides structured, queue-safe automation for Unity Editor assets, scenes, UI Toolkit, packages, tests, builds, and project workflows.
LongHaulText: The package evolves with real Unity projects and keeps ownership, diagnostics, reload safety, and reproducible evidence as first-class contracts.
ReviewText: Open the standalone repository for source, changelog, releases, and issues.
